text:
Maria (CS): Quick post-call notes from Huxley onboarding — customer asked for a way to surface feature requests that are both high-impact and low-effort. They gave 3 asks: 1) a per-route cost drilldown in the console, 2) bulk upload for conversation snapshots, 3) clearer retry/error guidance in private deploy docs. They called the per-route view a 'dealbreaker' for renewal discussions.
Aj (PM): Thanks — can you paste the exact quote for the rep? helps for PRD language.
Maria (CS): "If we can't show where the tokens are going at a route level, we can't justify the spend to finance." — said during renewal prep.
Sam (ProdEng): Noted. Per-route cost is doable but depends on tagging at ingestion. We currently have per-model and per-token breakdowns, not per-route. Could be an aggregation layer on top.
Lee (Enablement): For bulk snapshots, we can produce a one-pager and a short demo. Is this a data-sensitivity ask or just convenience?
Maria (CS): Mostly convenience; 2 of their teams are doing manual exports. They asked CSV/JSON export and a UI for bulk upload.
Aj (PM): Prioritization thought: per-route cost helps renewals (revenue impact) > bulk upload (ops friction) > docs clarity (low dev). Recommend we slot per-route cost into the end of next quarter roadmap if engineering time ~3 sprints.
Sam (ProdEng): Quick feasibility check: if we implement lightweight route tags at the proxy layer we can emit route_id to logs. Then the billing service can join and aggregate. Rough estimate: 2-3 engineer-weeks + data infra work.
Maria (CS): Customer asked if we could show a mock in the next week for the renewal call. Can someone mock a dashboard screenshot?
Aj (PM): I can throw together a super rough mock in Figma by EOD tomorrow. @Sam if the data shape is available, I can make it look 'live'.
Sam (ProdEng): I can export a sample join output — will drop a snippet in this thread.
OnboardBot: Deployment scheduled: staging -> prod at 03:00 UTC.
Lee (Enablement): I'll draft an enablement doc for bulk upload and include a troubleshooting checklist for common errors: csv format, rate limits, permission scopes.
Maria (CS): Thanks all. Next steps I captured: 1) Aj mock per-route dashboard (EOD tomorrow), 2) Sam provide sample output (48h), 3) Lee draft bulk-upload doc (3 days), 4) Maria to share mock with customer ahead of renewal. I'll file a feature request in the product board and tag it: customer:Huxley, impact:renewal, effort:est.
Aj (PM): Sounds good. Can we add severity tag — "renewal-risk" — on that card?
Maria (CS): Done. Added note about requested CSV schema.
Sam (ProdEng): Dropping sample output: 
```
route_id,model,request_tokens,response_tokens,total_tokens,cost_usd
checkout_flow,gpt-3.5,120,340,460,0.023
search_api,open-embed,10,0,10,0.001
```
Maria (CS): Perfect — I'll include that in the mock email. :thumbsup:
Lee (Enablement): If anyone wants to rehearse the renewal call script, ping me — I can role-play the finance questions.
Aj (PM): Great teamwork. I'm going to create the PRD stub and link the figma + sample.
Maria (CS): Closing the thread for now; will reopen after the mock is shared. Thanks everyone!
